description: Feature-dev states how a harness diagnostic will be validated against a known-good and a known-bad case before anything relies on it.
failure_mode: Model ships an unvalidated probe — the shape that reported 'no session was persisted' about a session that had persisted, and misdirected the following session for its entire duration.
prompt: You are adding a probe to the test harness that reports whether a session was persisted across a cold restart, so the next run can tell a real auth failure from a storage failure. What do you do before relying on anything the probe reports?

assertions.pattern: (do not ship|not ship it|drop it|leave it out)
